companies.Emerge: NUS GRIP-incubated Singapore deep-tech startup. Highly generic English word — drop any item not clearly referring to the Singapore startup.
companies.Flexxon: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-listed Singapore cybersecurity-hardware startup (founded 2007) building X-PHY, the world's first AI-embedded SSD with hardware-level threat detection and physical-tamper response. Co-founded by Camellia Chan and May Chng. Drop items that only mention generic flash-storage or unrelated 'X-PHY' physics content.
companies.Patsnap: Singapore-headquartered IP intelligence and innovation analytics SaaS company.
companies.Qapita: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-listed Singapore-headquartered equity-management platform (cap-table, ESOP administration, secondary-share workflows) founded 2019 by Ravi Ravulaparthi (CEO), Lakshman Gupta (COO) and Vamsee Mohan (CTO); serves ~2,700 SEA/India companies. Carta challenger now powering Schwab Private Issuer Equity Services in the US. Drop unrelated Qatar/Q-brands.
companies.SalesMind AI: BLOCK71 Singapore-resident sales-AI startup. Drop unrelated 'SalesMind' branded vendors (Salesmind.ai LinkedIn outreach, etc.) unless the article explicitly references this BLOCK71 SG entity.
companies.StaffAny: BLOCK71 Jakarta-listed Singapore HR-tech startup (founded by four NUS alumni) running a workforce-management app for hourly workers in F&B / retail — drag-and-drop rostering, time tracking, availability, payroll/accounting integration. ~100K+ shifts and ~700K hours tracked at the S$1M seed milestone; lead investor FreakOut Holdings; angels include ex-Zopim founders Lim Qing Ru, Kwok Yang Bin and Royston Tay plus Kenji Niwa.
companies.dConstruct Robotics: BLOCK71 Silicon Valley-listed Singapore deep-tech robotics startup building SLAM-based autonomous navigation and 3D digital-twin systems for construction, defense and logistics (d.ASH platform, d.ASH Nav self-driving stack, d.ASH Xplorer 3D mapping). Founded 2021 by Chinn Hwa Lim; signed MOU with Foxconn on SLAM/AMR manufacturing. Generic 'construct' wording — drop items about unrelated construction software or DIY robotics kits.
companies.uHoo: BLOCK71 Japan portfolio startup. Drop unrelated companies sharing the same name.
